snippet.title: Modulus - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase
snippet.description:
Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

Adicione a sua lista de desejos Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2779120/Modulus/
